prompt_text: Who is the best marketing agency in Maryland?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t a single “best” marketing agency for everyone — the right one depends on your goals, industry, budget, and whether you need local vs. national reach. I can help pick the best fit for you, but first I need a bit more info.

Quick checklist to help you choose the best agency
- What do you need? (SEO, PPC, social media, creative/branding, content, PR, full‑service)
- Industry experience: Do you need B2B, healthcare, e‑commerce, nonprofit, franchise, etc.?
- Budget and timeline: monthly retainer or project, and how soon you need results
- Size preference: boutique/specialist vs. mid‑size vs. large agency
- Location: Maryland city or region (Baltimore, Annapolis, Columbia, Eastern Shore) — is proximity important?
- Success metrics: leads, revenue, brand awareness, app installs, store traffic?

What I can do next
- If you tell me your answers to the bullets above, I’ll research and give a short, prioritized list of Maryland agencies that match your needs (including specialties, strengths, recent work, and contact tips).
- Or, if you want to evaluate agencies yourself, I can send a short RFP template and a list of the top questions to ask during calls.

Which would you prefer? If you want me to recommend agencies, tell me: city/region, marketing services needed, industry, and budget range.
